pitch_en: Uses fluorescent tracer technology and a proprietary app to provide real-time hydrological data — flow rates and velocities — for water resource management.
pitch_es: Usa tecnología de trazadores fluorescentes y una app propia para proporcionar datos hidrológicos en tiempo real — caudales y velocidades — para la gestión de recursos hídricos.

sections.head_en: Water bodies used for environmental studies often lack affordable, reliable real-time hydrological data on flows and dispersion.
